features: UNLIMITED CAPABILITIES: the 120 pcs mini-sized magnetic tiles master playset comes in different shapes and colors, 2 magnetic feet characters, and 1 regular brick compatible building car base with wheels that can transform your magnet shapes into a truck or train

BEST TRAVEL ROAD TRIP TOY: The mini-sized magnet tiles are designed for your little ones’ small hands that can be grabbed easily and stacked effortlessly on any flat surface. Bring them in the backpack or store them in the original packaging as a storage box for a short weekend getaway road trip or play on long-distance flights.

SHINNY DIAMOND EFFECT: Unlike the regular one-color clear see-through magnetic tiles, PicassoTiles’ mini diamond series are all finished in a beautiful glossy diamond effect which adds depth to your building toy collections. The open-ended possibilities of structures will keep your children occupied and busy for hours

NOTABLE LEARNING: Play and combine magnetic blocks in ways with no restrictions - all with fun, hands-on play. Encourage fun learning at a young age that will create memorable experiences for your child while enhancing your child’s STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art & Mathematics) skills early on

ENDLESS ENTERTAINMENT: Enjoyable for single or multiple parties to fulfill the sense of achievement together. This 120 pcs mini magnetic tiles building set is BPA-FREE, NON-TOXIC, and suitable for any age (6+ and up). Let your imagination run wild and challenge others! Keep your hands busy, interact in groups and spend quality time with close friends and family designing something amazing and incredible!
